propositions: Inbound reconcile writes STATUS events directly via _write_event_file, bypassing the parent-first cascade invariant enforced in interactive transition_compute/claim_compute
An inbound Jira status change moving a child to an active status does not pull ancestors along, allowing invalid states (closed parent holding open/in_progress child)

The operator ruling mandates that no non-terminal-state ticket can be a child of a closed ticket, requiring the inbound-reconcile surface to uphold the same parent-first invariant as the interactive cascade

The fix implements _cascade_inbound_status_parents as a helper that single-sources the cascade decision from _CASCADING_EDGES and _resolve_parent_in_status, writing eligible ancestors' STATUS events first before the child
Inbound status writes are suppressed as no-ops when the target status equals the current local status, preventing cascaded parents from fighting their own inbound mutations in the same batch
